records-db-mcp._comment: Local Python MCP server exposing generic CRUD tools over data/records_compliance.db plus a redact_pii_text utility. This server is NOT exemption-aware — statutory disclosure exemption checking is enforced by agents/records_foia_agent/graph.py before any content reaches the LLM. No external secrets required.

tools.name: db_read_record
tools.description: Fetches rows matching query_params from 'public_records' or 'foia_requests'.

query_params.description: Column-value pairs to filter by, e.g. {"record_id": "REC-2026-101"}.

tools.name: db_create_record
tools.description: Inserts a new row into 'public_records' or 'foia_requests'.

tools.name: db_update_record
tools.description: Updates an existing row in 'public_records' or 'foia_requests'.

key_value.description: Value of key_field identifying the row.

tools.name: redact_pii_text
tools.description: Replaces Social Security Numbers, phone numbers, and email addresses with [REDACTED PII].
